topics.text: Democrats outline first-100-hours agenda: restore ACA subsidies, reverse Medicaid cuts, curb tariffs, end Iran war
Democrats form working groups on gas, groceries, utilities, housing, and caregiving, per Hakeem Jeffries
Senate races in Alaska and Mississippi remain uncalled; Mississippi ballot counting could take several days
Democrats flip at least seven Senate seats and two dozen House seats in Tuesday's midterm elections
Trump says Iran war costs hurt Republicans; Iran's Strait of Hormuz blockade aimed at energy crisis, per analyst Trita Parsi
Dow falls over 1,300 points and Nasdaq drops 4.5% in midday market selloff
Elon Musk faces possible congressional investigations after spending over $400 million backing Republicans in midterms
Russell Brand convicted in Britain of one count of rape and three counts of sexual assault
Three people injured in shootings at a Des Moines, Iowa, post office; suspect in custody
